publisher: NASA LP DAAC / product science team
facts: A1 stores daily maximum-class composites, with water/cloud precedence adjustment. It is not one composite across eight days.
QA retains land/water state and day/night, not complete L2 algorithm QA or a per-pass count.
Dates metadata maps each retained daily plane; fewer planes can occur when observations are unavailable.
FirePix, CloudPix, UnknownPix and MissingPix summarize composited grid cells per day; they are not pass counts.
Fire-only scan sample and maximum FRP cannot reconstruct histories of nonfire observations.
